sourceAssessment: Confirmed exact two-path delta. Existing createPrivateBokEscrow returns a frozen literal with enumerable own string metadata and method properties; the former Proxy get replacement violates frozen property invariants.

Distinct frozen method map covers every current actual escrow method. Metadata identity and mode references are retained unchanged; each wrapper is constructed once, preserving stable function identity. Reflect.apply invokes the original method on the original port with unchanged arguments.

Every method schedules through the same existing service-wide walletOperation lane used for original escrow construction and other requests. The lane preserves each caller rejection while catching only its scheduling tail, so one failed operation cannot overlap or poison later scheduling.

Original escrow exclusive methods, lease checks, canonical inspection, fee/proof configuration, durable pre-send intent, unknown-result fence and operation replay restrictions are unchanged. No provider, model, secret or service capability is introduced.
Object.entries is sufficient for the inspected actual frozen literal port; this is a concrete composition adapter, not a generic proxy replacement for arbitrary inherited/symbol/nonenumerable APIs.

evidence.originalProxyRegression: 3 controlled failures preserved, including runPrivateBokRequest TypeError
evidence.scope: Controlled chain/provider fixtures; no actual provider or service run by reviewer or component tests. No RSS measurement claimed.

limitations: Live original-journal hosted service recovery and paid provider/reply/final-accounting acceptance remain separate.
